title: Power-torsion submodules of an injective module over a Noetherian ring are injective
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for an injective module over a Noetherian ring the submodule of elements annihilated by a power of a single element, and more generally the power-torsion submodule of an ideal, are injective (author lemma at source lines 552-561, label lemma-injective-module-divide). The proof (source lines 563-588) uses the essential-extension criterion, argues with the annihilator ideal made finitely generated by Noetherianity to produce an element meeting the torsion part trivially, and reduces the ideal case to the single-element case by iteration (proof lines 563-587). The annihilator argument is the substance. H3.
